title: Routes, HTTP & API Serialization
intro: Applies to: route files, middleware wiring, Form Request field rules, HTTP statuses, API resources, response shape, inbound webhooks.

Lane boundaries: Form Request shape (array-syntax rules, `authorize()` plus `rules()`, no inline `$request->validate()`) is owned by `orchestration-di.md`. This file owns what the rules accept and how input reaches the handler.

entries.rule: Each module **MUST** own its route file (`{module}-routes.php`), loaded by the module's service provider. A module route file loaded with `loadRoutesFrom()` **MUST** declare its `api` prefix and `api` middleware explicitly, because `loadRoutesFrom()` adds neither (`Route::prefix('api')->middleware('api')->group(...)`).

Each user intent **MUST** have its own route; one endpoint **MUST NOT** pick its action from the request body. One endpoint serving several intents forces a single authorization rule to cover all of them.
entries.why: One endpoint serving several intents forces a single authorization rule to cover all of them.

entries.rule: Every route **MUST** be named, following `{module}.{resource}.{action}` (`commerce.orders.create`). Thin public one-off routes **MAY** use a simple single-segment name.

Route parameters **MUST** be plain ids resolved inside the query/command handler. Route-model binding **MUST NOT** be used; implicit binding hides the lookup, skips the ownership gate, and couples routes to Eloquent.
entries.why: implicit binding hides the lookup, skips the ownership gate, and couples routes to Eloquent

checks.coverage: Flags a controller action parameter typed as an Eloquent model, which is route-model binding.

entries.rule: Middleware aliases and groups **MUST** be registered in `bootstrap/app.php`; route files only apply them by name, they do not define them.

State-changing routes and owned-data routes **MUST** sit inside an auth middleware group (`auth:sanctum`, plus `verified` for sensitive operations). Only genuinely public reads **MAY** live outside it.
Abuse-prone endpoints (login, signup, email resend, password reset) **MUST** carry a `throttle:` limiter.
Privileged writes **MUST** carry capability middleware (`abilities:` / `can:`) referencing a typed constant, never a magic string (see `authorization.md`).
Each write action **MUST** have its own Form Request; a request **MUST NOT** branch on `isMethod()` to serve several actions.

checks.coverage: Flags a call to isMethod() inside a Form Request class.

entries.lane_note: Form Request shape (array-syntax rules, `authorize()` plus `rules()`, no inline `$request->validate()`) is owned by `orchestration-di.md`. This file owns what the rules accept and how input reaches the handler.

entries.rule: Every field the handler reads **MUST** be `required`, or `required` plus `nullable`, or given an explicit default in the Form Request; `sometimes` **MUST NOT** be used for a field the handler reads.

entries.rule: Fields an endpoint ignores **SHOULD** be marked `prohibited` so clients get a 422 instead of a silent 204.
entries.why: clients get a 422 instead of a silent 204

entries.rule: Date inputs **MUST** be validated with `date_format:Y-m-d` (or an explicit format) and read with `$request->date()`, never the loose `date` rule.
entries.lane_note: Form Request shape (array-syntax rules, `authorize()` plus `rules()`, no inline `$request->validate()`) is owned by `orchestration-di.md`. This file owns what the rules accept and how input reaches the handler.

entries.rule: Client-chosen sort and filter columns **MUST** be validated with `Rule::enum()` and mapped to columns you chose to expose; raw input never reaches `orderBy()` or `where()` as a column name.
entries.lane_note: Form Request shape (array-syntax rules, `authorize()` plus `rules()`, no inline `$request->validate()`) is owned by `orchestration-di.md`. This file owns what the rules accept and how input reaches the handler.

entries.rule: A field rule **MUST** stay in the Form Request even when a value object also enforces it, so form users get a field-level 422 instead of a 500 (the value object's invariants are in `models-domain.md`).
entries.why: form users get a field-level 422 instead of a 500

entries.rule: `validated()` **MUST NOT** be spread into `create()`/`update()`; the handler **MUST** list the columns it writes. Models are unguarded (see `models-domain.md`), so every validated key would become a column write.
entries.why: Models are unguarded (see `models-domain.md`), so every validated key would become a column write.

checks.coverage: Flags validated() passed straight into create() or update().

entries.rule: Create **MUST** return 201 (via the resource's `withResponse()` or `->response()->setStatusCode(201)`).
State changes and deletes **MUST** return 204 with no body.

entries.note: A create returning 200, or a delete returning a body, is a violation.

entries.rule: Responses **MUST** be built by dedicated `JsonResource` classes; controllers never hand-assemble arrays.

checks.coverage: Flags a controller action whose return type is array.

entries.rule: A resource **MUST NOT** manually map a collection (`$this->items->map(...)`); nested relations get their own resource class and `::collection()`.
A resource **MUST** read typed DTO/model properties, never associative-array keys; the feeding handler returns a Result DTO.
Keys **MUST** be snake_case; a single object is wrapped in `data`; collections add `meta` and `links`; errors are a bare `message` (plus `errors` for validation) with no `data` wrapper.
Dates **MUST** serialize via `->toIso8601String()`.
Optional/relation fields **MUST** be conditional (`when(...)`, `whenLoaded(...)`).

Every API controller **MUST** carry attribute-driven documentation (Scribe's `#[Endpoint]`, `#[Group]`, `#[Response]`, plus `#[Authenticated]` and `#[UrlParam]` where relevant, from the `knuckleswtf/scribe` package, or an equivalent generator's attributes). An undocumented endpoint is incomplete work.
entries.why: An undocumented endpoint is incomplete work.

entries.rule: The `#[Response]` example **MUST** match the resource's actual output shape, with realistic example data; a documented shape that lies is worse than none.
entries.why: a documented shape that lies is worse than none

entries.rule: Every route parameter **MUST** have a matching `#[UrlParam]`.

Webhook routes **MUST** live in their own route file loaded via `loadRoutesFrom()`, behind a signature-verification middleware, CSRF-excepted in `bootstrap/app.php`, and **MUST NOT** sit behind user auth middleware.

Webhook processing **MUST** be queued and **MUST** be idempotent with tracking: check an idempotency key against a tracking record and no-op on repeats BEFORE any domain work; then record the outcome (`markProcessed()` / `markFailed($error)`), with the domain work wrapped so the tracking record always settles.
Webhook jobs **MUST** declare explicit `$tries` and `$backoff`.

checks.coverage: Flags a webhook job class that declares no $tries or $backoff property.
